notes:
Recent discovery -> moved to evaluation. Oxley runs a knowledge-base SaaS for mid-market B2B customers (docs, release notes, FAQs). Primary ask: embeddings + reranker stack to surface canonical answers and surface-turn reranking to increase precision at low latency. Indexing target: ~1.2M docs (avg 400 tokens) -> expect ~4M passage embeddings post-split. Traffic: very spiky; steady-state QPS target 300-500, peak bursts to 1k for product incidents. Cost sensitivity: internal goal <$0.002/query average (embeddings + rerank).

Notes from demo: "Liked Redwood streaming API and model routing — want hosted first, may explore dedicated later." AE pointed out smart-routing for cheaper fallbacks. Customer cares about tail latency: p95 <120ms for retrieval+rerank when using a 3-stage pipeline (ANN -> embeddings rerank -> distilled reranker). Legal flagged data residency for EU customers (subset of corpus).

Quotes: "We cannot have >200ms p95 during incident surges or PS will be flooded." — Head of Platform. POC ask: show 2-week perf run with synthetic QPS 500 p95, cost breakdown per 10k queries, and reranker throughput numbers.

technical_requirements: Support for incremental indexing + efficient upserts (daily batch + live edits)
Embedding dimension preference: 1536 or quantized 1024 for cost tradeoff
Reranker must accept candidate set sizes 32-128 and work in streaming mode
Automatic fallback to cheaper model variant during capacity constraints
sizing_estimates: Storage: estimated 45-70GB of raw embedding vectors (float16 quantization planned)
QPS: steady 300-500, peak bursts to 1000 for incident windows
Throughput need: reranker capacity ~1200 qps equivalent if batched; prefer server-side batching
